purpose: Teach: アキ/垂れ/行儀/ドーナツ/スナック/埃/味わえる/うんと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの友達のアキさん、本気で、絶対、優しい人なのよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、紹介、絶対、するからね、約束。
lines.en: Sho — my friend Aki is genuinely such a kind person. I'm going to introduce you two for sure, okay? Promise.
lines.style: Warm, genuine enthusiasm. Leans in like sharing something precious. Steady eye contact. The rhythm of someone who's thought about this. Soft emphasis on the promise at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お味噌、絶対、垂れちゃったよ、ぼく、絶対、ふきんで、絶対、拭くね
lines.en: Mei-sis — I spilled miso! I'll wipe it up with the cloth right away.
lines.style: Quick, concerned, eager to fix it. Sharp intake at the realization. Moves into action-speak without waiting for permission. The careful attentiveness of a younger child who doesn't want to disappoint.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、行儀、絶対、よくしてるね、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、感心しちゃう
lines.en: You've got such good manners, Sho. I'm really impressed.
lines.style: Gentle, genuine praise. Not patronizing — noticing something real. Warm tone, steady pace. The kind of admiration that makes a child feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ドーナツ、絶対、買ってきたよ、お土産、本気で、絶対、嬉しい?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis brought donuts home as a surprise! Are you happy?
lines.style: Brightening mid-sentence. Testing her reaction, needing confirmation. The small hope in his voice. Quick, eager delivery — childlike anticipation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園で、本気で、絶対、スナック、絶対、シェアして、絶対、食べようね、翔くん、約束
lines.en: Let's go to the park and share the snacks there, okay? Promise?
lines.style: Bright, inviting, inclusive. Opens the idea like an invitation. Warm tone, light pace. The promise feels like safety, not obligation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの家、本気で、絶対、埃、絶対、ないよね、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お掃除、絶対、上手
lines.en: Your home is so clean, Mei-sis. You're really good at tidying up.
lines.style: Genuine observation. Quiet respect in the delivery. Not flattery — noticing something he values about her. Soft, sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんの味、絶対、味わえる料理、翔くんに、絶対、作ってあげるね、本気で、絶対、約束、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: I'm going to make you a dish with my grandmother's flavors, Sho. Real promise. I mean it.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverential about the inheritance. Slower pace. Emphasis on the reality of the promise — she's anchoring something. Breath under the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、うんと、絶対、楽しい時間、絶対、過ごしたいよ、お願い、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: I want to spend lots and lots of fun time with you, Mei-sis. Please? I promise.
lines.style: Earnest, reaching. Quiet vulnerability underneath the brightness. The word 'lots' repeats with genuine longing. Trails slightly on the please, like he's checking if it's safe to need this.
